BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled along a peaceful country lane in the heart of North County Dublin, this exceptional detached dormer bungalow offers the perfect blend of rural tranquillity and modern family living. Extending to an impressive 254 sq.m. (2,734 sq.ft.), the property enjoys a stunning south-facing aspect, capturing uninterrupted panoramic views across rolling countryside towards the Dublin Mountains, while remaining just 20 minutes from Swords and 40 minutes from Dublin City Centre.

Originally a charming cottage, the home has been thoughtfully extended and modernised to create a spacious and versatile family residence full of character and natural light.
The welcoming entrance hallway leads into the original cottage, where you'll find a beautifully appointed modern kitchen/dining room, a separate utility room, downstairs bathroom, a spacious living room complete with a feature wood-burning stove, and a generous ground floor bedroom, offering excellent flexibility for guests, multi-generational living or a home office.

The original cottage seamlessly connects to the impressive modern extension, which boasts a bright open-plan kitchen, dining and living space designed for contemporary family life. A second utility room provides additional practicality, while the living area opens into a magnificent south-facing sunroom. Flooded with natural light, this wonderful space perfectly frames the breath-taking countryside views, creating an idyllic setting to relax and entertain throughout the year.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises four spacious double bedrooms, all benefiting from excellent storage. The impressive principal bedroom is particularly generous in
size, featuring a private ensuite and spectacular uninterrupted views over the surrounding fields towards the Dublin Mountains. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

Outside, the property continues to impress with ample off-street parking, mature grounds and a substantial steel storage shed, ideal for hobbyists, tradespeople or additional storage.

The true highlight of this outstanding home is its enviable south-facing orientation, ensuring sunshine throughout the day while making the most of the spectacular rural scenery. Offering peace, privacy and space without compromising on convenience, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy country living within easy commuting distance of Dublin.
Leastown Lane enjoys an idyllic setting in the picturesque village of Oldtown, a thriving rural community renowned for its welcoming atmosphere and beautiful countryside.
Despite its peaceful surroundings, the property is exceptionally well connected, with Swords just a 20-minute drive away, Dublin Airport within easy reach, and Dublin City Centre approximately 40 minutes by car.

Oldtown offers an excellent range of local amenities including primary schools, shops, cafés, sporting clubs and community facilities. Nearby Ashbourne, Swords and Ballyboughal provide an extensive selection of supermarkets, restaurants, secondary schools and leisure facilities.
For outdoor enthusiasts, the surrounding countryside offers scenic walking and cycling routes, while golf courses, equestrian centres and GAA clubs are all close at hand.
Excellent road connections via the M1, M2 and M50 ensure convenient access to Dublin City, Dublin Airport and the wider commuter belt.
Combining generous family accommodation, breathtaking south-facing countryside views and an enviable location, Leastown Lane presents a truly exceptional lifestyle opportunity.
